Hi Marta / David —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our side so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard from OliveTech on the call:
- Need a private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with strict network isolation (no public egress by default)
- HIPAA coverage required for PHI; GDPR data residency and DPA required for EU flows
- You'd like us to initiate the vendor security questionnaire (VQ) and share architecture artifacts

What Redwood will provide / actions: 
- Share our VQ template and SOC 2 Type II summary (full report available under NDA) — attached: Redwood-Private-deployment-overview.pdf
- Kick off formal VQ exchange once you confirm the preferred sharing method (Box/SharePoint/SecureLink)
- Outline options for private deployments: 1) VPC deployment with PrivateLink/peering and customer-managed KMS; 2) Air-gapped on-prem package (limited maintenance windows) — we can draw a diagram for either path
- Schedule a technical deep-dive next week (propose week of May 17) to go through networking, KMS, and operational responsibilities

Requested from OliveTech: 
- Completed vendor questionnaire or a contact to send the VQ to (security or procurement)
- Any existing network constraints (e.g., strictly no outbound, allowed IP ranges, required proxies)
- Point-of-contact for legal/procurement to discuss contractual terms and DPA

Next steps / proposed timeline:
1) We send VQ template + sample deployment diagram (today) — ACTION: Redwood
2) OliveTech returns completed VQ or indicates preferred file exchange method — ACTION: OliveTech
3) Technical deep-dive (network + KMS + air-gap feasibility) — target week of May 17 — ACTION: all

Attachments: Redwood-Private-deployment-overview.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to the formal security intake.

Best,

Subject: Re: Private deployment security discovery — SOC 2 / GDPR / VQ kickoff

Thanks, Priyom — good summary. A few clarifications from OliveTech: 

- SOC 2: We require vendors to have SOC 2 Type II. Can you confirm Redwood's current status and expected timeline for the full report? We are particularly interested in CC6 controls around encryption and access controls.
- HIPAA: Yes, HIPAA coverage is required for the PHI workflows we plan to send. Please outline whether Redwood's hosted or dedicated options are covered, and whether onboarding an air-gapped on-prem package would allow us to maintain compliance.
- Network: Our standard for anything handling PHI is default-deny (no outbound internet egress). Where outbound is required (updates/metrics), we need an approved list of FQDNs/IPs and an option to route through our proxy.
- KMS: We require BYOK (bring-your-own-key) with customer-controlled rotation for production KMS. HSM-backed keys preferred.

Attached is our initial security questionnaire spreadsheet (OliveTech-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx) — we've highlighted the high-priority items. Please route this to your security/infra team.

For file exchange, we prefer Box or an SFTP transfer with an audit trail. Procurement is copied — their POC is procurement@olivetech.com.

If you can confirm the SOC 2 snapshot and share the VQ template and sample network diagram, we can start completing the spreadsheet. Also happy to schedule the technical deep-dive w/ our infra lead (David).

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Security & Compliance, OliveTech
Marta.Ruiz@olivetech.com | +1 212-555-8891

Hi Marta / David — thanks for the details and the questionnaire. I'm Karthik from Redwood's infra/security group — following up with technical answers and next steps.

SOC 2 / compliance artifacts:
- Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type II for our core hosted and dedicated services (reports available to customers under NDA). We can share a SOC 2 summary and control mappings for CC6.
- For Private/on-prem packages, we maintain the same baseline controls; some controls map differently for air-gapped installs (we'll document the operational responsibilities).

Deployment & network options (high level):
1) VPC-hosted Private deployment (preferred for most customers):
   - PrivateLink / VPC peering with no public ingress. Outbound egress can be restricted; we can provide a minimal set of egress endpoints for auto-updates/telemetry if required.
   - Supports BYOK via customer-managed KMS (we integrate with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and can support HSM-backed keys).
2) Air-gapped on-prem package:
   - Fully isolated deployable bundle; patching and telemetry done through secured offline media or via a controlled bastion (customer decides frequency).
   - Support windows are limited; on-prem package requires an SOW for on-site or remote install support.

Vendor questionnaire process:
- We'll start by returning our VQ template (Redwood-VQ-template.pdf) with answers for items we control. For items requiring OliveTech input (network policies, proxy config), we'll flag them for you to complete.
- Preferred exchange: Box link with ACLs and audit logs. We can also support SFTP if you provide the host + account.

Attachments included for your review: Redwood-VQ-template.pdf, deployment-diagram-sample.png

Technical deep-dive: propose a 60-minute session with our infra engineer (Neha) + your infra lead (David) to validate networking/KMS constraints. Available slots: Tue 2026-05-18 09:00-11:00 PT or Wed 2026-05-19 13:00-15:00 PT. Please confirm which works.

Let us know procurement/legal POC so we can send the NDA/SOC 2 access link.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
